name: @openbnb/mcp-server-airbnb
description: MCP server for Airbnb search and listing details
author: OpenBnB (https://openbnb.org)

scripts.build: node sync-version.js && tsc && shx chmod +x dist/*.js
scripts.pack: npm run build && npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . dist/mcp-server-airbnb.mcpb
scripts.test: node --test test-availability.js test-pricing.js test-filters.js test-listing.js test-booking.js test-partial-stays.js && node test-extension.js && node test-amenities.js
scripts.test:offline: node --test --test-skip-pattern=^live test-availability.js test-pricing.js test-filters.js test-listing.js test-booking.js test-partial-stays.js
scripts.test:availability: npm run build && node --test test-availability.js test-filters.js
